newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 37,600 MT were 42 percent above the week earlier and 51 percent over the 4-week average. Turkey (15,000 MT) was the primary buyer, with smaller quantities to Mexico (3,200 MT--of which 3,000 MT was rough), Canada (3,100 MT), Ghana (3,000 MT), the Netherlands (2,900 MT), Haiti (2,900 MT), the Dominican Republic (2,500 MT), and Liberia (2,000 MT).

Exports of 49,100 MT were 19 percent below the week earlier and 18 percent under the 4-week average. The major destinations were Turkey (15,000 MT), the Netherlands (13,600 MT), South Africa (6,400 MT), Costa Rica (4,900 MT), and Mexico (4,000 MT).
